task_context.problem_statement: Hot dog buns come in packages of 8. For the school picnic, Mr. Gates bought 30 packages of hot dog buns. He has four classes with 30 students in each class. How many hot dog buns can each of Mr. Gates' students get?
task_context.reference_solution:
Mr. Gates bought 30 x 8 = <<30*8=240>>240 hot dog buns.
In his four classes, he has a total of 4 x 30 = <<4*30=120>>120 students.
Therefore, each of his students can get 240/120 = <<240/120=2>>2 hot dog buns.
